title: AlexCustomMSG
description: A lovingly crafted private messaging plugin by LoveStudio
body:
> ✨ A modern, soft, customizable private messaging plugin — built with love, emotion, and full PlaceholderAPI support. ✨

## **💖 Why AlexCustomMSG?**
Other /msg plugins? They’re fine.
But AlexCustomMSG isn’t just fine — it’s ✨ yours. It’s deeply customizable, gentle on the eyes, powerful in its logic, and soft in its intention.

We believe that communication in Minecraft should feel beautiful — not just functional. Whether you're a cozy server admin, a roleplay worldbuilder, or just someone who wants messages to feel personal, this plugin is made with love for you. 🥺💞

## **🌟 Features**
- ✉️ Custom /msg and /r commands with color formatting & hover/click events
- 🔕 Ignore system with persistent UUID support (even works offline!)
- 💬 Multi-line messages with full config.yml support
- 🎨 Fully PlaceholderAPI-compatible
- 🔊 Configurable sounds for incoming messages
- 🪶 Reloadable config without restart
- 🌈 Soft and simple UX — easy to use, yet powerful
- 🧩 Plug-and-play — no external dependencies required (but PlaceholderAPI supported!)

## **🔐 Permissions Support**
Granular permissions for `/msg`, `/r`, `/ignore`, `/unignore`, `/ignorelist`, and `/acmsgreload`.
Or just give `acmsg.*` for full access 🧙‍♂️

## **⚙️ Compatibility**
| ✔ Feature          | ✅ Status                        |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------- |
| Minecraft Versions | 1.18.2 – 1.21+                  |
| Java Versions      | Java 17+                        |
| Server Software    | Paper, Purpur, Spigot, Folia    |
| PlaceholderAPI     | Optional, but fully supported ✅ |

## **🥹 Final Words**
You can download a dozen /msg plugins.
But only one of them was built with love.

> AlexCustomMSG — because even whispers deserve to feel warm. 💌🌿
